tools.name: conformance_check
tools.description: run one full client x IdP-shape conformance matrix (the POST /check operation; x402 $0.01 per check unless your account has an active Solo subscription/trial, metered exactly as REST)

tools.name: claim_trial
tools.description: claim the one-time free first Solo month for your first server (the POST /trial/claim operation; Bearer token required)

tools.name: subscribe_solo
tools.description: activate/extend a subscription via x402 X-PAYMENT header (the POST /subscribe operation; Bearer token required): Solo $9/mo per server by default, or Fleet $29/mo for up to 10 servers with tier=fleet (WO-F-P22-17/RT-20 — the tier parameter is advertised here exactly as in the REST OpenAPI)

tools.name: run_history
tools.description: list only your own account's past matrix runs (the GET /history operation; Bearer token required)

tools.name: subscription_status
tools.description: your account's subscription status (the GET /subscription operation; Bearer token required)

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: conformance_check · Private data: claim_trial, subscribe_solo, run_history, subscription_status · Public sink: conformance_check, claim_trial, subscribe_solo · Destructive: conformance_check, run_history.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: conformance_check · Private data: claim_trial, subscribe_solo, run_history, subscription_status · Public sink: conformance_check, claim_trial, subscribe_solo · Destructive: conformance_check, run_history

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "subscribe_solo" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "activate/extend a Solo month, $9 via x402 X-PAYMENT header (the POST /subscribe operation; Bearer token required)" → after: "activate/extend a subscription via x402 X-PAYMENT header (the POST /subscribe operation; Bearer token required): Solo $9/mo per server by default, or Fleet $29/mo for up to 10 servers with tier=fleet (WO-F-P22-17/RT-20 — the tier parameter is advertised here exactly as in the REST OpenAPI)"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
